doc.name: Aworkado
doc.instructions: Aworkado lists live remote and hybrid jobs, collected daily from employers' own career pages. Use search_jobs to find postings (filter by job function, the countries the user can work from, region, seniority and recency), and get_job for the full posting. Always give the user the Aworkado link of each posting: the job page has the Apply button.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.title: Search remote and hybrid jobs
tools.description: Search live remote and hybrid job postings on Aworkado, collected daily from employers' own career pages. Returns up to 10 of the newest matching postings with their Aworkado links, and the total number of matches. All filters are optional and combine with AND.

query.description: Keywords matched against the job title and the company name, e.g. "python backend" or "Stripe".

jobFunction.description: One job function, exactly as listed: Software Engineering, Data & Analytics, DevOps & Cloud, QA & Testing, IT & Security, Hardware Engineering, Product Management, Project Management, Design, Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Account Management, Customer Support, Operations, Finance & Accounting, HR & Recruiting, Legal & Compliance, Writing & Content, Education & Training, Healthcare, Research, Consulting, Administrative, Other.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries the candidate can work from, e.g. ["IN", "PH"]. A posting matches when it is open to any of them.

region.description: A region instead of single countries: europe, latin-america, asia, africa, middle-east, north-america, oceania, or anywhere (postings open worldwide).

workplace.description: remote or hybrid. Leave out for both.

postedWithin.description: Only postings published within the last day, week or month.

tools.name: browse_jobs
tools.title: Browse job results
tools.description: The job widget's paged search. Same filters as search_jobs; level takes a comma-separated list.

tools.name: get_job
tools.title: Get a job posting
tools.description: The full posting behind one search_jobs result: description, pay, locations, seniority and its Aworkado link, where the candidate applies.

jobId.description: The id of a search_jobs result.

resources.name: job-results
resources.title: Job results
resources.description: Cards for the postings a search_jobs call returned.
